derivation: the main flow works. 1 thing in the build does not match what you asked for — the mix-ratio status line (t-3-ac1) — and none of them is from the PRD itself: worth reading before you merge.

criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: Every batch is there in one list, one line each — B-1041, B-1042 and B-1043 stacked directly under the header, just as the concept asks.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row is right on the board — a 'new batch code' input with an ADD BATCH button beside it, so a batch goes in without leaving the page.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: An orange band across the top reads GROUT TRACKER (rgb(224,138,60)) — the board names itself, exactly as drawn.

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The list sits immediately below the header — the header ends at y=51 and the list starts at y=71, with nothing between them.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: The ADD BATCH button is to the right of the input — the input runs x=20 to 1283 and the button starts at x=1293, teal (rgb(90,166,184)).

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has an orange mix-ratio line ('MIX RATIO 3:1 · 2 BATCHES OPEN') sitting beneath the add row. It isn't there at all — below the add row the page drops straight to the footer.
Nothing on screen can settle this, but your own tests cover it and it passes.

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: I could not check this. The suite is green, but its CSV tests exercise a parser ('handles quoted commas', 'trims whitespace') — nothing in the output speaks to the export writing valid CSV with a header row, so a passing run does not prove it.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: an orange mix-ratio line beneath the add row
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer

alsoChecked: A footer reading 'grout tracker · sandbox build' sits at the bottom; the drawing says nothing about a footer, so I'm treating it as the builder's call.
The ADD BATCH button is teal (rgb(90,166,184)); the concept says its colour is the builder's call, so that's fine.
No console errors were reported on the page.
summary: The board itself is right: GROUT TRACKER names it in the orange header, all three batches show in one list directly beneath, and the add row with its ADD BATCH button to the right lets a tiler add without leaving the page. Two gaps hold it back from clean: the mix-ratio status line your drawing puts beneath the add row is missing entirely, and I can't confirm the CSV export writes a header row — the passing tests only exercise a CSV parser, not the export. Persistence across a restart is covered and passes.
